meta.name: caveman-stats
meta.description: Show recorded output and cache-read token usage and mode attribution for the current Claude Code session, or locate the host's native usage report. Trigger: /caveman-stats.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查看当前会话的输出与缓存读取 token 用量及模式归属
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想弄清这次会话到底消耗了多少 token。
copy.tagline_en: Check token and cache-read usage and mode attribution for the current session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know how many tokens this session actually used

howto.what: 输入 /caveman-stats 后,它会原样打印当前 Claude Code 会话已记录的输出 token、缓存读取 token、响应次数和模式归因,不自行重算或取整。
howto.when: 在 Claude Code 里输入 /caveman-stats 时触发;在 Gemini CLI 中则会引导你改用 /stats model、/stats session 等内置命令。

say.note: 原样打印本会话已记录的用量报告
按会话聚合最新一次输出计数
只聚合最近 7 天的数据

howto.what_en: After you run /caveman-stats, it prints the current Claude Code session's recorded output tokens, cache-read tokens, response counts and mode attribution verbatim, without recalculating or re-rounding the numbers yourself.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type /caveman-stats in Claude Code; in Gemini CLI it instead points you to built-in commands like /stats model or /stats session.

say_en.note: Prints the recorded usage report verbatim
Aggregates latest output count per session
